target_customer: Small construction businesses in Brazil such as remodelers, contractors, architects and engineering firms
problem: Small builders manage estimates, purchasing and projects with spreadsheets and paper, losing time on manual procurement and estimation.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscriptions with a free tier, plus planned supplier marketplace and construction insurance

founders.name: Ythalo Silva
previous_startups: Modiax (crypto exchange, acquired by Foxbit in 2019)
A business started in college that failed
founders.background_notes: Partner and EIR at MAR Ventures per YC page.

founders.name: Guilherme Guerra
education: Civil engineering, Federal University of Espirito Santo

founders.name: Fabio Witt
education: Stanford and CSU Chico via Science without Borders scholarship

investors: Angels from the Corona and Goldfarb families

competitors.name: Obra Prima (01 Tecnologia)
competitors.what: Mobile management app for small builders, backed by Senior

competitors.name: Juntos Somos Mais
competitors.what: Construction supply platform from a joint venture of Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau and Tigre
competitors.funding_then: Backed by three large industrial groups

technical_complexity.rationale: Estimation, procurement and project modules with local practices such as the ABC curve are standard SaaS engineering with domain complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Project and cost data, a client portal and local practices create switching costs, and a large free user base gives distribution.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copy documented; Vobi was still operating in 2026 and added AI agents.

market_need_then: Brazilian small builders relied on spreadsheets and paper; the company reported a little over 35 thousand customers including free users at the end of 2021.

branding.domain_note: Uses vobi.com.br, a Brazil country domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and conversational, second person questions about pain points

rebrands.why: Per a search summary, the team reused customers from its earlier remodeling platform HomeHero; I could not confirm on a primary page.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct short name and a nationwide customer base, though no press on the brand itself was found.

pivots.to: Vobi, project management for construction SMBs
pivots.why: Based on a search summary of Brazilian press; the reason is not stated.

outcome_analysis: Vobi grew from a remodeling marketplace into a construction management SaaS with a free tier and over 35 thousand users by the end of 2021. It raised about 7 million reais in February 2022 led by Y Combinator with MAR Ventures and angels. By 2026 it claims nationwide presence and AI agents, with a 45 person team; no later round was found.
notes: The round was stated as 7 million reais by Baguete, NeoFeed and Startupi; amount_usd is null because I did not convert currency. A directory lists total raised of about 1.85M USD. Site claims of 5 billion reais of works are self reported. Founder list taken from the YC page; confirm Fabio Witt role label.
